advanceTime.description: Advance in-story time. Call this only when the plot really spans time (travelling, a long conversation, sleeping, waiting for nightfall, recovering for days). If the turn is just a few lines or actions, do not call it. There is no upper bound on the span.
advanceTime.step: How many units to advance; a positive integer. Defaults to 1
advanceTime.unit: Time unit. Defaults to segment (one part of the day, about 4 hours)
advanceTime.reason: Why time passes (recorded on the timeline)
